snippet.title: Tanuki: Pon’s Summer - Radical Hats Trailer | CRTime
snippet.description:
Pon seems to have got his paws on some familiar looking hats….

It’s almost time for the Tanuki Festival! Pon has 1 month to deliver packages, help out the townsfolk and bring the shrine back to its former glory.

Play the first 3 hours of the game on Steam NOW! Your save game will carry over from the demo to the full game when it releases.

Wishlist Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3218570/TANUKI_Pons_Summer/
